name: slack
title: Slack Web API
summary: chat.postMessage, conversations, users, reactions and auth.test with Slack's HTTP 200 ok:false errors, plus channel-not-found, ratelimited and outage scenarios.

upstream.notes: Swagger 2.0, archived by Slack in 2021 (last commit 2021-09-07), so newer methods are missing. It declares token as a required header parameter, so under --full a call that sends only Authorization: Bearer is answered 400 from the default response; it also has GET-only auth.test, conversations.*, users.* where the SDKs POST.
